create_AssignResult: create an AssignResult storing assignments between predicted and ground truth boxes with gt_inds and labels
generate_random_AssignResult: generate a random AssignResult for testing with configurable num_preds num_gts and assignment probabilities
add_gt_labels_AssignResult: add ground truth labels to an AssignResult by concatenating gt_inds max_overlaps and labels
get_AssignResult_info: get a dictionary of info about an AssignResult including num_gts num_preds gt_inds and labels
set_extra_property_AssignResult: set a user-defined extra property on an AssignResult instance by key and value
